articleTitle: What Research Says About Postpartum Return to Exercise
imageHeadline: Cleared at 6 weeks doesn't mean ready to run
imageSubtext: What the research actually says about postpartum return to exercise
pinTitle: Postpartum Return to Exercise: What Research Says About the 6-Week Clearance
pinDescription: The 6-week checkup clears you medically, but that's not the same as your pelvic floor and core being ready for your old training load. The evidence supports a gradual, symptom-guided return: walking and core work first, then low-impact strength, and high-impact exercise only when your body can handle it without leaking, pressure, or pain. Learn what a realistic progression looks like.

items.label: Start with walking and pelvic floor activation
Add low-impact strength as core rebuilds
Progress to running only when symptom-free
Scale back if leaking, pressure, or pain appear
